description: When will AGI-level systems be achieved? Estimates range from 'within this decade' to 'never' to 'already here.' All three camps reference this claim; interpretations and implied policy conclusions diverge.

instances.assertion: Placeholder instance. Add real document instances as sources are ingested.
GPT-4 scored in the 15th percentile on the essay and performance test portions of the bar exam among those who passed.
More than a third of respondents said they were concerned that A.I. would end human life on earth.
There is no evidence that current forms of AI present an existential risk.
There is a >10% chance of existential catastrophe by 2070 from power-seeking AI.
AI systems can now solve International Mathematical Olympiad problems at a gold-medal level.
AGI models that match or surpass human cognitive capabilities on any task are imminent, just two or three years away.
AI systems have approached and exceeded human-level performance in tasks like scientific reasoning.
Chinese tech companies have focused intensely on real-world applications for A.I. while American companies focus on abstract goals like AGI.
The term 'Artificial General Intelligence' (AGI) lacks a precise, universally agreed-upon definition in industry or academia.
AGI systems could plausibly be developed by 2030, necessitating an 'anytime' safety approach that can be implemented quickly.
AI poses catastrophic and existential risks.
The aggregate forecast of AI researchers for a 50% chance of AGI arrival shifted from 2060 in 2022 to 2047 in 2023.
The aggregate forecast of AI researchers for a 50% chance of AGI dropped from 2060 in 2022 to 2047 in 2023.
AGI is often predicted to arrive within an arbitrary six-to-ten-year timeline.
Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis predicts AGI capabilities will emerge within 5 to 10 years.
